## Review checklist

- [ ] Original source located and checked.
- [ ] Attribution and title are source-supported or explicitly marked unknown.
- [ ] Original text is distinguishable from edited text.
- [ ] Dates and version history are supported.
- [ ] Rights and publication state are reviewed.
- [ ] Private data and third-party personal information are handled appropriately.
- [ ] Any AI-assisted synthesis is labeled and links to its sources.
- [ ] Relevant indexes use relative links.
